description: Push the leads the brand's LEAD FORMS collected into HubSpot as contacts — Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok (every published Instant Form, every lead region), X Ads, Snapchat and ChatGPT Ads (the last two: leads delivered to Hermoso by their lead webhooks). Each lead is upserted by email with lead status NEW and the platform + form + campaign written into the contact's Message property (a default HubSpot property, so no schema scope is needed). Synced lead ids are remembered per workspace, so a re-run, a scheduled run, a retry or a second agent never creates twins. Reports created / updated / already-synced / no-email per platform; a platform that is not connected, or cannot be read (Reddit has no API for leads), is REPORTED, not fatal. platforms narrows it. dryRun:true lists what would be synced and writes nothing. set_hubspot_lead_sync runs it automatically. Free. Needs HubSpot connected, plus the platforms whose leads you want.

tiktokRegions.description: TikTok stores leads per region; default all three
